player_signal: PLAYER HEALTH readout, numeric health, percentage, and STABLE/LOW/CRITICAL label
implemented_behavior: HealthBar and HealthLabelText update every HUD refresh with high-contrast aware green/amber/red state colors.

player_signal: Damage taken from zombie, boss, elite, or special attack
implemented_behavior: DamageMercyWindowSeconds, MaxEnemyDamagePerHitFraction, bPreventSingleHitEnemyDeaths, and armor reduction prevent ordinary repeated hits from instantly deleting a healthy player.

player_signal: ATTACKED FROM alert and debug damage message
implemented_behavior: LastDamageMitigationText records mercy window, per-hit cap, armor plate, survival lock, and emergency medkit so the HUD names why the hit was survivable.
bAutoUseEmergencyMedkit, EmergencyMedkitHealthFraction, and EmergencyMedkitCooldownSeconds trigger a subtitle-backed automatic recovery when the player is near failure.
Death screen pauses the world and offers resume from language save, start fresh language run, save language run and quit, or quit to desktop.

player_signal: High contrast and reduced motion toggles
implemented_behavior: Damage overlay and HUD alert refresh live accessibility state while preserving text-first source/direction/distance feedback.
